findings.title: TEDİ opens a 279 sqm home and lifestyle store at V Metroway AVM, Istanbul
findings.summary: Home and lifestyle retailer TEDİ opened a 279 sqm store on level -2 of V Metroway AVM in Istanbul on 24 Oct 2026, selling home decoration, kitchenware, stationery, toys, hobby and party goods and everyday items on an affordable-price pitch. AVM Dergi says the mall is continuing to widen its brand mix; Mall Report carried the same opening on 28 Oct.
findings.why: A dated tenant addition at a listed Istanbul mall, and a sign that V Metroway is still adding brands.

findings.title: Meta launches its Muse shopping and task agent in Singapore, with Shopee, Grab and Lazada among the partners
findings.summary:
Meta made Muse, its personal AI agent, available in Singapore on 28 Oct on iOS, Android and muse.ai, with Shopee, Grab, Singapore Airlines, Agoda and ShopBack named at launch and Klook, Trip.com and Lazada as further partners. Muse compares products and prices, builds a Grab basket and places the order only after the user approves, and books Klook experiences in the chat; passwords and payment methods are kept out of the agent's view in a dedicated cloud environment.

Muse is free for most everyday uses, with paid plans for more, and connector features roll out over time. No Middle East launch was mentioned.
findings.why: Marketplaces and delivery apps chose to plug into a consumer agent that buys only with the shopper's approval, the decision GCC retailers and mall apps face if Muse reaches the region.

findings.title: Kuwaiti home furnishing group ABYAT nears the opening of its first Qatar store, a flagship at Mall of Qatar
findings.summary: ABYAT, a home finishing and furnishing group founded in Kuwait in 2005, says its first Qatar store, a flagship at Mall of Qatar, opens soon, without giving a date or store size. It marked its Qatar debut as official home partner of Build Your House Qatar 2026 (26 to 28 Oct, Qatar National Convention Centre). ABYAT says it carries more than 30,000 products, runs showrooms in Kuwait and Saudi Arabia and manufactures at ABYAT Industrial City in Saudi Arabia; Mall of Qatar first announced the showroom in March 2024.
findings.why: A regional home-furnishing anchor entering Qatar through Mall of Qatar adds a large tenant to the listing, two and a half years after it was first announced.
